mentions.name: DeepCost.ai
mentions.description: An AI-driven cloud cost optimization tool for AWS, GCP, and Azure that shows where cloud spend is leaking and automatically reduces waste such as idle resources, over-provisioned workloads, inefficient Kubernetes setups, and AI API usage. Setup is lightweight and it focuses on actionable recommendations rather than massive dashboards.
mentions.problem: Cloud spend leaks through idle resources, over-provisioned workloads, inefficient Kubernetes setups, and AI API usage, and small teams lack cost visibility without running a full FinOps practice.
mentions.audience: Small teams and fast-growing startups that want better cloud cost visibility without running a full FinOps practice.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on DeepCost.ai, an AI-driven cloud cost optimization tool for AWS, GCP, and Azure.
